shared_elements: incised outline drawing rather than modelled volume
justification: Both are shallow incised/low-relief carvings in grey stone using outlined curvilinear scrolls, discs and a framing band, which is the most concrete correspondence. But A is a tall three-dimensional anthropomorphic monolith whose ornament is stacked in horizontal registers over a body, while B is a flat rectangular panel dominated by a single framed quadruped in profile, so the compositional schemes and formats have essentially nothing in common.
